notes: LIGO O3 search for scalar field dark matter via beamsplitter/test-mass size oscillations. Constrains BOTH the photon coupling Lambda_gamma (d_e, ScalarPhoton) AND electron-mass coupling Lambda_e (d_me, ScalarElectron); the two cannot be distinguished (mu = Lambda_i^-2). I selected ScalarPhoton but ScalarElectron is equally valid - hence low confidence. Limits (95% C.L.) are presented only as curves in Fig. 3 versus frequency; no numerical coupling values are given in the text, so no data points could be extracted. Frequency band 10-180 Hz corresponds to ~5e-14 to 1e-12 eV, competitive up to 5000 Hz (~2e-11 eV).
